title: Nazi missions to Antarctica
summary: Lou Elizondo tells of Nazi missions to Antarctica, about an unknown time at Antarctica, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they were they were fascinated Antarctica they had several missions down there

plain: A researcher named Lue Elizondo says the Nazis were fascinated by Antarctica and sent several missions there. He mentions it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, as part of a talk about what Germany was exploring in that era.
